k4c4ced1c:
Think of "About" as this machine's manual: the version number, when updates are checked, what environment this machine runs, and where to find logs when something goes wrong—all on one page.

How updates work:

- The installed build checks and downloads silently in the background at startup without getting in your way; only when the download finishes does a full-screen prompt appear with "Install now / Later"
- To check right away: Settings → About → Check for updates; the result appears under the button
- To keep it offline: turn off "Automatically check for updates at startup" on the same page, and requests only happen when you click manually
- If installation fails, you can choose "Keep using"; repeated failures automatically fall back to a usable state. You can also download manually from the release page and install over the current version

When troubleshooting:

- Settings → About → Folders and diagnostics: open the app data, runtime logs, and crash dumps folders with one click each
- "Copy diagnostic info" puts the version, system, Electron version, and all three paths on the clipboard, ready to paste to a developer
- When an error banner appears at the top, you can retry directly—failures are never disguised as an empty library

Use the shortcut panel under `?` or this tutorial to cover most "where do I click?" questions.
